tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Use this when the user is shopping for a jawline exerciser, jaw trainer, chewing/face-fitness device, or wants to see JAWD products. Do not use for medical jaw pain, TMJ, orthodontic, or dental questions.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Use this when the user names a JAWD product or SKU and wants current price, stock, image, or a product link. Do not use for medical jaw pain, TMJ, orthodontic, or dental questions.

tools.name: recommend_routine
tools.description: Use this when the user asks how to start or structure jaw or face exercise. General fitness guidance only; no medical, cosmetic-outcome, or weight-loss claims. Do not use for medical jaw pain, TMJ, orthodontic, or dental questions.

tools.name: build_cart
tools.description: Use this only after the user picks a product and quantity and asks to buy. Returns an external Shopify checkout link on JAWD's store; nothing is charged in ChatGPT. Do not use for medical jaw pain, TMJ, orthodontic, or dental questions.
